name: hn-mod
description: A programmable Hacker News trend widget for Claude Code, powered by TinyFish Search and Fetch

tinyfish_api_key.title: TinyFish API key
tinyfish_api_key.description: Key from agent.tinyfish.ai/api-keys. Leave it empty to use the TINYFISH_API_KEY variable or the login of the tinyfish CLI.

tinyfish_cli.title: TinyFish CLI command
tinyfish_cli.description: The command the mod runs when no API key is set

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that writes card specs, digests, themes and thread summaries

snapshot_minutes.title: Snapshot interval (minutes)
snapshot_minutes.description: How often the widget reads the HN lists to measure points per hour

auto_open.title: Open at session start
auto_open.description: Open the HN pulse pane when a session starts
